summary: No concrete defects found in the compare implementation, tests, or CLI. The reviewer separately reported an integration blocker in interaction/check.mjs:30, outside this packet scope.
review_report: W1 read-only review outcome: accepted, no concrete defects found in gobi/compare_interaction.go, its tests, or cmd/compare-interaction/main.go. The comparator validates levels, requires >=1 initial tick and sequential indexes, requires empty initial steps, compares step/state/tree every tick and DOM/pixels by requested level, rejects absent pixel hashes at SamePixels, and ignores mutations as documented. CLI validates one JSON path and non-null golden/candidate, invokes SameDOM, emits Diff JSON, exits 0 on match, 1 on diff, 2 on usage/read/parse/encode errors. Full go test ./... passes, including gobi tests. Separately identified an integration blocker in interaction/check.mjs:30 (nested template literal unescaped) and sent details to root; unrelated to XR-compare.
out_of_scope_finding: Reviewer reports a nested template literal parse issue at interaction/check.mjs:30; sent to coordinator.
